title: Billing and Marketplace readiness before public launch claims
objective: Verify billing, App, and Marketplace launch claims against dry-run release evidence and roadmap acceptance criteria before any public copy says they are live.
source_rule: Launch claims must not outrun audited billing state; dry-run evidence is not live billing.
allowed_evidence: release checklist and dry-run release evidence
GitHub Marketplace listing draft and review notes
billing audit: plans, seats, subscriptions, entitlements, overage, downgrade/cancel
forbidden_actions: creating or editing GitHub Marketplace listings
changing plan limits, subscriptions, seats, or entitlements
claiming live billing readiness from dry-run evidence alone
acceptance_gates: billing audit names plans, seats, subscription state, overage, downgrade, and failure modes
Marketplace listing is reviewed but not published from this run
launch copy distinguishes dry-run evidence from live billing state
roadmap acceptance criteria for billing are checked off explicitly
